fields.label: Sales Lot / Lote de Venta
fields.description: The FoxPro lote_de_venta as shipped. Verbatim: a sales lot is a historic fact, never re-derived.

fields.label: Folio
fields.description: Production folio carried with the sales lot. Data, not Int: FoxPro folios are not guaranteed numeric and a leading zero is meaning, not formatting.

fields.label: Customer / Cliente
fields.description: Customer as recorded historically. Deliberately Data, NOT Link: the legacy value may name a customer that no longer exists, and a broken Link would block the save.

fields.label: Year
fields.description: Recorded year. Data rather than Int so a blank or a legacy non-numeric survives import unchanged.
